build.buildCommand: cd nougram_front && test -n "$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL" && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build && mkdir -p .next/standalone/.next && cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static && cp -R public .next/standalone/public

deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'if [ -f nougram_front/.next/standalone/server.js ]; then cd nougram_front && HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 exec node .next/standalone/server.js; else alembic upgrade head && exec gunicorn main:app -c gunicorn_config.py -w 1 -b 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8000}; fi'
